name: Maiev Shadowsong
title: The Warden
description: A relentless hunter who uses shadow-blinking steps to close distances instantly and strike high-priority targets from behind.

name: Akama
title: Elder of the Ashtongue
description: A stealthy guerilla fighter who coats his kamas in crackling electric charges, delivering high-crit lethal strike combos from the shadows.

name: Michelle Myerina
title: The Shape
description: A stalker, able to grow stronger the longer she follows her targets, attack damage accumulation has no limit and cannot be reset. She is able to set teleport anchors and create fake clones allowing her to stalk anxious targets unaware of her real position.

name: Roeli
title: The Red Hood
description: A colorblind sniper able to precisely shoot red targets and change the color of anything in his POV allowing him to hit anything without missing.

name: Simulacra
title: The Ghoul
description: An acrobatic cannibal assassin with momentary stealth giving him enough time to slash through targets with his two daggers in the windy forest at night. Character with the highest movement speed but has the least health.

name: MoonBlade
title: Black Barron
description: Beneath her quiet, studious appearance lies an assassin who strikes in total silence. Wearing dark rimmed glasses and wielding a lethal dark scythe, MoonBlade moves through the moonlight like a fleeting phantom. She leaves no footprints, no echoes, and no survivors, only a lingering cold twilight in her wake.
